blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Power prices in the country’s spot market rose again in September because of outages at generation facilities and higher consumption. The system-wide average Wholesale Electricity Spot Market (WESM) price inched up 3.1 percent to P7.43 per kilowatt-hour (kWh) from P7.21 per kWh a month ago. READ: Higher September power bills seen in VisMin The billing period ran from August 26 to September 25, but the prices will appear on consumer bills this month. Luzon saw the biggest jump, up 5.7 percent to P5.18 per kWh from P4.90 in August. Supply improved by 4.3 percent to 15,114 megawatts (MW), […]...
